title: Design System: SellHub Home — Export Declaration Surface

headline.purpose: Masthead H1 only, one instance per page.

label.purpose: Field-box labels, serial numbers, market codes, candidate IDs, footer reference, CTA text.

body.purpose: All Korean sentence-level copy inside field panes and lists.

components.name: FieldBox
components.description: Numbered field: label strip over a padded content pane. The page's repeating structural unit.
components.html:

Field content goes here.
components.css: .ds-fieldbox { border: 1px solid rgba(28,27,41,0.7); } .ds-fieldbox-label { border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(28,27,41,0.7); background: rgba(28,27,41,0.03); padding: 6px 16px; font-family: 'SUSE Mono', 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.14em; color: rgba(28,27,41,0.55); } .ds-fieldbox-body { padding: 16px 20px; font-family: 'Pretendard Variable', 'Malgun Gothic', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.75; color: rgba(28,27,41,0.8); }

components.name: Candidate Slot — Default
components.description: One of nine identical unmatched candidate cells in the repeating candidate row.
components.css: .ds-slot { border: 1px solid rgba(28,27,41,0.25); color: rgba(28,27,41,0.4); text-align: center; padding: 12px 8px; font-family: 'SUSE Mono', monospace; } .ds-slot-no { font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; } .ds-slot-mark { margin-top: 8px; font-size: 15px; } .ds-slot-tag { margin-top: 4px; font-size: 8px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; }

components.name: Candidate Slot — Matched
components.description: The single highlighted candidate cell representing the AI-matched buyer, styled by color swap only.
components.css: .ds-slot--matched { border: 1px solid #4fa8dd; background: #4fa8dd; color: #ffffff; text-align: center; padding: 12px 8px; font-family: 'SUSE Mono', monospace; transition: background-color 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-slot--matched .ds-slot-no, .ds-slot--matched .ds-slot-tag { font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; } .ds-slot--matched .ds-slot-mark { margin-top: 8px; font-size: 15px; }

components.name: Submit Button
components.description: The page's single CTA, styled as the declaration form's approval/submit action, on the navy 'Final authorisation' field.
components.css: .ds-btn-submit { background: #ffffff; color: #060f1c; border: 1px solid #ffffff; padding: 12px 32px; font-family: 'SUSE Mono', monospace; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.02em; border-radius: 0; transition: background-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-submit:hover, .ds-btn-submit:focus-visible { background: #eef7fd; } .ds-btn-submit:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2f7fb3; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: The homepage abandons the hero/feature-grid/CTA scroll and instead renders as a single completed, approved Korean customs export declaration (수출신고필증): an off-white paper field (#f7f7f6), a full-bleed black-ink rule around every module, numbered field boxes, dashed cut-lines between declared items, and a rotated red-tinted 'approved' stamp bleeding over the top-right corner. SellHub's existing brand blue is repurposed as the 'matched/approved' status color; the existing coral accent is promoted to stamp-ink duty. Nothing here is a generic marketing layout with form styling applied on top — the form's own numbering and field grammar is the page structure, which is why the numbered boxes are an earned exception to the platform's usual 'no bare section numbers' default: the sequence is load-bearing, copied from a real declaration form's field order, not decorative.
keyCharacteristics: Off-white paper ground, full-width black-ink rules, zero corner radius, zero shadow.
Every content module is a numbered FieldBox: a thin label strip (NN. Label) over a padded content pane.
One repeating grid of identical candidate slots with exactly one slot recolored solid brand-blue.
SUSE Mono in a single weight (700, uppercase, tight tracking) carries every non-body string.
The final CTA is field 18, 'Final authorisation,' on a deep navy ground with a white rectangular Submit button.

rules.name: The Ink-Opacity Rule
rules.body: There is one ink color (#1c1b29). Every visual weight of border, divider, and secondary text is an opacity step of that ink, never a second gray hex. A new gray value is a violation, not a variant.

rules.name: The One Highlight Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue fills exactly one element on the page at a time (the matched candidate slot). Everything else that isn't ink-on-paper or the stamp's coral is either full ink or an ink opacity step.

rules.name: The One-Weight Mono Rule
rules.body: SUSE Mono ships at a single weight (700) and a single case (uppercase) everywhere it appears. There is no regular-weight or mixed-case use of the display font on this surface.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: This surface uses zero box-shadow. Any future addition to this page that reaches for a shadow for elevation has left the paper-and-ink world; use a border-weight or opacity step instead.

dos: Do use SUSE Mono at weight 700, uppercase, for every field label, serial number, market code, and CTA string — never for a full paragraph of Korean body copy.
Do keep the single ink color (#1c1b29) and vary only its opacity for every border/divider/secondary-text weight; don't introduce a second gray.

Do number a field only when the number is a real declaration-form field number carried by the page's own document metaphor; the exception exists because the sequence is load-bearing here, not by default for future pages.
Do tell a 'one match among many' story through a single solid-color fill inside an otherwise identical repeating grid row, not a card or badge.
donts: Don't add a box-shadow anywhere on this surface — depth is ink-weight and opacity, not light.
Don't add corner radius to any box, chip, or button; the form's rectilinear grid is the whole shape language.

Don't treat the numbered-field device or the SUSE Mono declaration voice as a global system rule — both are scoped to this one surface's document metaphor, not a precedent for other SellHub or Searching Hub pages.

Don't carry the check/cross Unicode glyphs used here for the candidate-match mark and the before/after list forward as this project's icon system; they are a defect of this build, not a documented component.
